title: Do not supply consumer goods covered by a ban
what: A person must not supply consumer goods of a kind covered by an interim or permanent ban (Australian Consumer Law s 118).

sources.title: Competition and Consumer Act 2010
sources.quote: 118 Supplying etc. consumer goods covered by a ban (1) A person must not, in trade or commerce, supply consumer goods of a particular kind if: (a) an interim ban on consumer goods of that kind is in force in the place where the supply occurs; or (b) a permanent ban on consumer goods of that kind is in force.
